node.statement: Because delta_n+epsilon_X<=(4*C_np+1)epsilon_X, the universal estimates in node 1.7 admit one finite universal coefficient K such that, simultaneously for all n, v_n is a K*epsilon_X-homomorphism and (1-K*epsilon_X)||x||<=||v_n(x)||<=(1+K*epsilon_X)||x||. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, the one map v^(2) is therefore an extended K*epsilon_X-inclusion; no level-dependent map or constant was chosen.
